description: Bulk delete entries matching kind/moduleName/tags filter. Requires confirm=true. Use before full re-import or to clear a module slice. Prefer replace-entries with deleteOrphans for idempotent sync.

confirm.description: Must be true to delete; safety guard against accidental bulk delete

moduleName.description: Only entries linked to this module

projectId.description: Required. Call list-projects first (query by workspace folder name) and pass the matching projectId. Never omit. default-project is forbidden.

tags.description: Entries having any of these tags

name: delete-entries
title: Delete Entries
